# Vendored Browser Dependencies

These files are pinned local browser builds used by OMODOS so production features do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

| Local file | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---:|---|
| html2canvas.min.js | html2canvas | 1.4.1 | MIT |
| jspdf.min.js | jspdf | 2.5.2 | MIT |
| docx.min.js | docx | 8.5.0 | MIT |
| xlsx.min.js | xlsx | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| exceljs.min.js | exceljs | 4.4.0 | MIT |
| chart.min.js | Chart.js | 4.5.1 | MIT |
| vis-network.min.js | vis-network | 9.1.9 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |

Exact source URLs and SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded in manifest.json.
